description: This file defines the class 'MacroExpression', which implements the 'Expression' interface. It models macro expressions used in a substitution or macro-processing system, including various nested classes for different types of expressions and their evaluation logic. It appears central to handling macro logic and expression parsing within the project.

classes.name: MacroExpression
classes.description: Represents a macro that defines an expression to evaluate, with support for attachments and nested expressions.

classes.name: MacroExpression.VariableExpression
classes.description: An inner class representing expressions with a single variable, with optional negation.

classes.name: MacroExpression.TokenExpression
classes.description: An inner class representing comparison operations between tokens, such as equality or inequality.

classes.name: MacroExpression.ComplexExpression
classes.description: Abstract base class for expressions composed of multiple sub-expressions.

classes.name: MacroExpression.AndExpression
classes.description: Represents a logical 'AND' of two expressions.

classes.name: MacroExpression.OrExpression
classes.description: Represents a logical 'OR' of two expressions.

classes.name: MacroExpression.NegateExpression
classes.description: Represents a negation of another expression.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the macro type (e.g., if, elseif, else, end).

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the content attached to this macro expression.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the content attached to this macro expression.

methods.name: appendAttachment
methods.description: Appends content to the existing attachment.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the macro expression against a Substitution context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the macro expression.
